-- Requests W1 started or that are blocked waiting for their cases, and the
-- day each workflow's "waits until tomorrow" notice was last posted.
SELECT coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
          'id', id, 'ticket', ticket, 'workflow', workflow, 'state', state, 'reason', reason,
          'attempts', attempts, 'notified', notified,
          'dispatched_at', to_char(dispatched_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')) ORDER BY id)
        FROM audit.w1_requests WHERE state IN ('dispatched', 'blocked')), '[]') AS requests,
       coalesce((SELECT json_object_agg(substr(name, 5), value) FROM audit.relay_state WHERE name LIKE 's11:%'), '{}') AS s11,
       coalesce((SELECT json_object_agg(ticket, pr_url) FROM audit.w1_requests
                 WHERE workflow = 'draft-cases' AND pr_url <> ''), '{}') AS cases_prs;

-- Save the decision; put a retry or a capped/disabled run back on the waiting
-- list with its masked text; remember the S11 day.
WITH saved AS (
  UPDATE audit.w1_requests
  SET state = $2, reason = $3, run_id = coalesce(nullif($4, '')::bigint, run_id),
      pr_url = CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN $5 ELSE pr_url END, notified = $6, updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING ticket, workflow, ticket_text
), queued AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.deferred_requests (action, workflow, target, payload, reason, not_before)
  SELECT 'dispatch', workflow, ticket, json_build_object('ticket', ticket, 'ticket_text', ticket_text)::jsonb, $7, $8::timestamptz
  FROM saved WHERE $7 <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (action, workflow, target) WHERE done_at IS NULL
  DO UPDATE SET reason = excluded.reason, not_before = excluded.not_before, payload = excluded.payload
  RETURNING id
), s11 AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.relay_state (name, value)
  SELECT 's11:' || workflow, $9 FROM saved WHERE $9 <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING name
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM saved) AS saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM queued) AS queued;
